d: Pakistan-administered Kashmir has witnessed weeks of unrest, protests, strikes and clashes between demonstrators and security forces. The protests, linked to grievances over governance, political representation, economic conditions and regional autonomy, have led to deaths, arrests and widespread disruption across the territory. Reports indicate that authorities imposed restrictions, communication blackouts and detentions as tensions escalated, while protesters have openly criticised Pakistan's establishment and security policies. Hem Saroya explains.
